en: The postcard features a black-and-white panoramic view of a city with a mixture of classical European-style buildings and abundant trees in the foreground. There is a mountainous landscape in the background. The bottom of the image has text in both Cyrillic and French, indicating a general view of the city. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Cyrillic script, a Bulgarian postage stamp with a profile portrait, postal stamps, and a library mark indicating it was cataloged by a regional library. The text and stamps confirm Bulgarian origin.
